definitions.explanation: A person's surname before marriage or a legal name change. In Japan, married couples must share one surname by law, so one partner's pre-marriage name becomes their former surname.

examples.japanese: {旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧です。
⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I continue to use my maiden name at work.

examples.japanese: {旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{認|みと}められていない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: More companies are allowing the use of maiden names, but it is not legally recognized.

notes:
USAGE:
Under Japanese law (⟦{民法|みんぽう}→民法：13239_minpou⟧), married couples must adopt the same surname. In practice, the wife usually takes the husband's name, making her pre-marriage name her {旧姓|きゅうせい}. The topic of {選択的|せんたくてき}⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧{別姓|べっせい} (optional separate surnames for married couples) is an ongoing social debate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use one's maiden name
- {旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧: to revert to one's maiden name
- {旧姓|きゅうせい}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧: use of maiden name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧: surname, family name
- {名字|みょうじ}: surname (everyday term)
- ⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧: real name
